notes: All 13 exams re-researched from live sources on 2026-11-17; every source URL below was actually fetched and its content extracted during this pass.

GATE PH 2026: the 10th section of the paper, General Aptitude (GA), is deliberately excluded from the topic lines (non-physics), per the ledger-building rules; the 9 physics sections are from the official IIT Guwahati GATE 2026 PH syllabus PDF.

CSIR NET Physical Sciences: the exam's common Part A (general aptitude/reasoning) is excluded as non-physics; the official CSIR HRDG subject document labels its two subject blocks PART 'A' CORE and PART 'B' ADVANCED (these are subject-content blocks, not the exam's aptitude Part A) and both blocks are recorded as stated, with prefixes to keep the 15 lines distinct.

JEE Advanced: the official site jeeadv.ac.in now hosts the 2027 cycle (IIT Delhi) whose syllabus page reads 'Coming soon ... This page will be updated shortly'; the previous (2026, IIT Roorkee) official site is offline. The current syllabus text (unchanged since the November 2021 revision, first implemented in 2023) was therefore taken from mirrors: Embibe (2025, full verbatim official text), cross-checked against Vedantu (2027 chapter breakdown) and Testbook (2026 chapter breakdown). Mirrors disagree on one section: two list 'Electromagnetic Waves' as a separate section while Testbook lists six sections only; it is included here and the ambiguity is recorded. 'Experimental Skills' (listed only by Vedantu, folded into 'General' in the official text) is not listed as a separate section.

JEE Main and NEET-UG: the 18 individually named experiments under the 'Experimental Skills' unit are recorded as separate topic lines in addition to the unit line, because they are the syllabus's named experiments (prescriptive, numbered content) rather than illustrative sub-bullets; both current syllabi carry the same 18-experiment list.

NEET-UG: the current syllabus is the NMC 'Syllabus for NEET (UG) - 2026' annexure carried in the official NTA notice PDF listed as a verified lead; NEET's Unit 1 is titled 'Physics and Measurement' (differs from JEE Main's 'Units and Measurements').

IB Physics: ibo.org is behind a Cloudflare challenge that never cleared (curl and headless browser both blocked), so the 2023-guide (first assessment May 2025) topic structure was reconstructed from two independent mirrors of the official guide structure — SaveMyExams and RevisionDojo — which agree on all 5 themes and all 24 sub-topics and on the HL-only markings (A.4, A.5, B.4, D.4, E.2). Both are marked 'mirror'.

IPhO: ipho.org is lapsed (its syllabus URL now serves a domain-parking redirect); the syllabus was fetched from ipho-new.org, the official IPhO website (it is the site linked as 'Official IPhO Website' by the community archive ipho-unofficial.org), and is embedded in the current Statutes & Syllabus page (amended at IPhO 2022 and IPhO 2023). The current syllabus uses the three-part structure: Theoretical skills / Experimental skills / Mathematics.

AP Physics C: the College Board course pages currently show the revised AP Physics C curricula (C: Mechanics units 1-7, C: Electricity and Magnetism units 8-13, numbering continuing across the two courses) — i.e. the revised framework now in force, not the pre-2024 'Newton's Laws / Systems of Particles' style outline; units were taken verbatim from the official apcentral.collegeboard.org pages.

Cambridge 9702: the current syllabus for exams through 2027 (2025-2027 syllabus, 25 numbered topics) was used from the official Cambridge International PDF; Cambridge has also published the 2028-2030 syllabus but it applies to exams from 2028.

CUET-UG: physics domain syllabus is the official NTA 'Physics - 322, For the Year 2026' PDF linked from the official CUET (UG) 2026 syllabus page on cuet.nta.nic.in (9 units, NCERT class-12 scope; no experimental-skills unit).
